name: Advanced Manufacturing Technology
description: Advanced manufacturing programmes train the people who keep a modern production line running — automation, controls, robotics, instrumentation and the mechanical systems underneath them. ⚠ It is the trade that sits where electrical work, mechanical work and programming meet, which is exactly why it is hard to fill.
degreesNote: Florida stacks this one from a very short entry point upward. The Certified Production Technology certificate is 300 hours and a single completion point — the fastest credential on this site — and it maps to the national MSSC Certified Production Technician assessments. Above it, Industrial Machinery and Controls Technician runs 1,200 hours across four completion points, from assistant to technician II. ⚠⚠ That second framework is new in 2025 and its course numbers have no carriers yet: colleges are still teaching the predecessor courses — production technology, automation, mechatronics and industrial machinery maintenance — so ask what a programme actually delivers rather than which framework it names. An associate degree in engineering technology sits above both.

cips.note: Electromechanical and instrumentation technologies — the whole family: 28 Florida public institutions, with 15.0406 (electromechanical technology) the largest single code at 16 institutions. ⚠ Claimed at series level deliberately, because Florida spreads this training across instrumentation, automation and electromechanical codes and a student searching one would miss the others.

related.note: ⚠ The nearest neighbour, and a genuine fork: an electrician wires buildings to the code, a manufacturing technician keeps machines and controls running inside one. Much of the first year is shared, and the two trades poach each other constantly.
The degree route above the certificates — and the usual next step for a technician moving toward automation engineering, maintenance planning or supervision.
The fabrication side of the same plant. Maintenance technicians who can weld are markedly more useful in a breakdown, and both certificates are taught at the same technical colleges.
